rule: Fill-path only, mapped by sheet geometry: each join targets the fillable cell whose printed caption (from the frozen page's own text layer, including runs positioned by transform) names the item and column (A. Taxpayer/Filer left, B. Spouse right). The sheet has no stamped name= inputs. The official submit loop writes only the radios/check boxes and the taxpayer name, so those come from the field map; every other printed value (identity, Items 13-18, all Part II/IV/V/VI amounts, Item 31 amounts, page 2 header) comes from derived: keys of to_print_field_map, never submitted. Amount boxes are 9-slot whole-peso combs (no cents comb): amounts print as digits without separators, right-aligned by left blanks, an overpayment in parentheses; Item 31 amounts keep centavos. The spouse column prints only on a joint return. Boxes print X when the writer value is true. Page 2's TIN comb has nine inputs and a preprinted 00000 branch, so it prints the 9-digit TIN only. Left blank on print because the model has no value for them: Item 33 signature line (p1c286), Item 35 number of attachments (p1c154, p1c155), Part III payment details (p1c164-p1c190). p1c51 is a 1pt sliver left of the Item 12 graduated box, not a box, and stays empty. Since #113 every value the print map carries has a box or a reviewed not_joined reason (the upload controls behind the derived: keys are listed there).
